code.purpose: Branches, paths, commands, hashes, and session identifiers.

shadows.name: overlay-only
shadows.purpose: Transient menus, sheets, and command palettes only.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, selection, and compact control state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background:#A0AEC0; color:#0D0D0D; border:0; border-radius:6px; padding:4px 8px; font:500 11px Geist,-apple-system,sans-serif; transition:background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:#CBD5E0; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #E2E8F0; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { background:#2D3748; color:#E2E8F0; border:1px solid #475569; border-radius:6px; padding:4px 8px; font:500 11px Geist,-apple-system,sans-serif; transition:background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background:#45546D; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #A0AEC0; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ticket Field
components.description: Compact Jira ticket entry with native field proportions.
components.css: .ds-ticket-field { background:#0D0D0D; color:#E2E8F0; border:1px solid #2D3748; border-radius:6px; padding:6px 8px; font:400 11px 'JetBrains Mono',monospace; } .ds-ticket-field:hover { border-color:#606A76; } .ds-ticket-field:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #A0AEC0; outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Textual workflow state that never relies on color alone.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; background:#2D3748; color:#E2E8F0; border-radius:6px; padding:3px 6px; font:500 11px Geist,-apple-system,sans-serif; }

components.name: Branch Row
components.description: One continuous operational row for a branch and its two agents.
components.css: .ds-branch-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr 1fr; gap:12px; align-items:center; background:#0D0D0D; color:#E2E8F0; border:1px solid #2D3748; border-radius:10px; padding:12px; font:400 12px Geist,-apple-system,sans-serif; } .ds-branch-row strong { font:600 11px 'JetBrains Mono',monospace; } .ds-branch-row:hover { background:#12161C; border-color:#474E57; } .ds-branch-row:focus-within { outline:2px solid #A0AEC0; outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Terminal Panel
components.html:
$ codex exec
Reviewing branch XFA-3299-login
components.css: .ds-terminal-panel { background:#080808; color:#E2E8F0; border:1px solid #2D3748; border-radius:10px; padding:12px; font:400 11px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono',monospace; } .ds-terminal-panel:hover { border-color:#474E57; } .ds-terminal-panel:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #A0AEC0; outline-offset:1px; }

narrative.overview: A quiet, precise macOS workspace where tickets, branches, agents, terminals, and human decisions share one stable hierarchy.

rules.name: The Signal Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Signal Slate marks selection or action, never decoration.

rules.name: The Mono Means Machine Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only for machine-facing values.

rules.name: The Surface Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use tone and separators before shadow.

dos: Do pair state color with text.
donts: Don't resemble a neon AI control room.
Don't build a wall of interchangeable cards.
Don't use decorative gradients, glassmorphism, animated agent avatars, oversized metrics, or vague status language.
